faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about your SAFAR eSIM

whatIsEsim.question: What is an eSIM?
whatIsEsim.answer: An eSIM is a digital SIM card that lets you access internet without a physical SIM.

roaming.question: Do I need to enable data roaming?
roaming.answer: Yes, roaming must be enabled for your eSIM to work abroad.

speed.question: What connection speed can I get?
speed.answer: Speed depends on the local network, usually 4G or 5G depending on the destination.

whatsapp.question: Can I keep my WhatsApp?
whatsapp.answer: Yes, your WhatsApp number stays the same with an eSIM.

receive.question: When will I receive my eSIM?
receive.answer: Your eSIM is sent instantly by email after purchase.

phones.question: Which phones are compatible?
phones.answer: Most recent smartphones support eSIM, including iPhone, Samsung and others.

calls.question: Can I call or send SMS?

why.question: Why choose eSIM SAFAR?
why.answer: We offer reliable connection in more than 160 destinations with fast activation.

dualSim.question: Can I use SIM and eSIM together?
dualSim.answer: Yes, most phones allow both to be used at the same time.

delete.question: How do I delete an eSIM?
delete.answer: You can delete it directly from your phone settings.

reuse.question: How many times can I use my eSIM?
reuse.answer: Each eSIM is valid for one use only, depending on the selected plan.

usage.question: How do I check my usage?
usage.answer: You can track your usage in your device settings.

setup.question: When should I set up my eSIM?
setup.answer: We recommend installing it before departure.

install.question: How do I install my eSIM?
install.answer: Scan the QR code received by email and follow the simple instructions.
